notes.title: Janosik 2 is Now Steam Deck Verified! Take the Adventure Anywhere
notes.content:
Great news, adventurers! 

[b]Janosik 2 is officially Steam Deck Verified,[/b] meaning you can now experience the thrilling highland journey wherever you go. Whether you're commuting, relaxing at home, or even exploring the real Slovakian Highlands, Janosik and his friends are ready to join you whenever, and wherever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a54f39f366c6e9a111ec60004d6544523698fa24.png[/img]

The "Verified" status means that [b]Janosik 2[/b] is fully optimized for Steam Deck, and there’s never been a better time to dive into the action. Don't wait and grab your Deck, prepare your thumbs, and get ready to venture into the highlands!

[h3][b]Upcoming Cloud Saves Update[/b][/h3]

Lately, we've been working on enabling [b]Cloud Saves for Janosik 2[/b], so your progress could carry onto another PC, or, more importantly, your [b]Steam Deck[/b]. While we have the PC - PC Cloud Saves working, the PC - Steam Deck situation proves to be more difficult than anticipated. At first, any solution we applied caused a total save wipe, which is a no go. We've managed to get a solution that works in most cases, however, in some instances it erases the latest save point, and the game puts you back at the second most recent save point. 

We're dedicated to making Cloud Saves work as intended, but it will require a rebuilding of the game's save system. And that in turn means most solutions result in progress loss - we're working to find a solution that doesn't interfere with the save files completely, We're aiming to have this update ready and live in a couple of weeks. We'll keep you posted with any updates regarding that!

As always, if you like Janosik 2 and enjoy your adventures, share our game with your friends, or leave a review to help us reach even more players!

Until next time!

notes.title: Patch #2 for Janosik 2!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

We're happy to see so many of you exploring the colorful world of [b]Janosik 2[/b] and enjoying the platforming challenges. To make your journey even better, we've released Patch #2, which focuses on resolving some pesky bugs and improving your gameplay experience. Here's what we've fixed:

[list]
[*] Fixed broken English dialogue for Mocarz when selling the Belt of Ammo upgrade.
[*] Resolved an issue where Janka's ice ability did not work because it overlapped with the dash ability.
[*] Fixed the incorrect switch position in Chain Reaction 3.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in a rock pillar when using the electroshock ability.
[*] Corrected an issue where the potion count display was partially covered by hearts when reaching double digits.
[/list]
If you’re enjoying [b]Janosik 2[/b], we’d greatly appreciate it if you shared the game with your friends or left a Steam review to help us reach more players.

notes.title: First Patch for Janosik 2 is Here!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!

First of all, thank you for playing [b]Janosik 2[/b], and all the feedback and bug reports over the course of last week. We've been looking closely at forums, comments, and Discord to make sure no message goes unnoticed. We've already pushed a couple of mini-updates containing changes to single lines in the dialogues and/or their localization.

Today, we're releasing a first, full-fledged, patch for Janosik 2.

[b]Here are the patch notes:[/b][list]
[*] Janka's wall clinging no longer emits the lantern sparkle sound.
[*] After getting an enchantment from the witch, the spellbook notification now clears immediately.
[*] Hugo's coffin no longer displays the hint E even if the controller is enabled.
[*] Fixed typos[list]
[*] "But you don't perish in sunlight nd don't drink blood." - and
[*] "Ans what's the third option?" - And
[*] "You well business idea was very creative." - Your
[*] "My souls is saved!" - soul
[*] "Hello, Hubertus. We've met a ghosts not too far from here..." - ghost
[*] "It was once a battle shield, it's made from real steal." - steel[/list][*] Corrected a misattribution[list]
[*] "What's worse, something happened in the nearby village. (...)" - this whole block had Janosik's portrait. It is now correctly attributed to Cyprian, the Treasure Fisher[/list][*] Slow effect from the large spider's web now clears immediately when the web disappears
[*] All levels achievement is now properly triggering
[*] Windowed mode no longer goes into MAXIMIZED between levels
[*] In the Chinese version of the game, after the dialogue with the Crazy Scientist in Level 20, the electric shock jump upgrade for Hugo is now working properly.
[*] Cloud sync should now work properly with Steam Deck
[*] The dialogue with Rob, who sells the bow, no longer appears a second time when visiting the Hunting Grounds level. As a result, he sells the same upgrade twice.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/c5123b5c6645a72dc83295c88fc8ba153702097f.png[/img]

We'd also like to take a moment to remind you that Janosik 2 has been nominated in the [b]IndieDB Indie of the Year 2024 Awards[/b] in the Platformer category! It would mean a world to us if you helped us get there! 

Every vote counts, and it only takes a moment of your time!
👉 [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2024-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100#vote85204]Follow this link to vote for Janosik 2: IndieDB Voting Page[/url]
[i](No registration required, so feel free to spread the word!)[/i]


If you’re enjoying Janosik 2, we’d greatly appreciate it if you shared the game with your friends or left a Steam review to help us reach more players.

notes.title: Janosik 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
[h3][b]The Wait is Over: Janosik 2 is Here![/b][/h3]
After three years of hard work [b]Janosik 2[/b] has officially launched! As the developer, I’m filled with a mix of excitement, anticipation, and a touch of anxiety. This game has been such a huge part of my life, and I can’t wait to see what you think about this next chapter in Janosik’s adventures. My goal has always been to make this sequel bigger, better, and even more immersive than the original [b]Janosik[/b].

[previewyoutube=KHsiIeIlNLo;full][/previewyoutube]

So, you're probably wondering what will you find in [b]Janosik 2[/b]... Well, obviously, there is a brand-new adventure, featuring werewolves, vampires, and a mission for Janosik to rescue Janka - his girlfriend. From there, the journey takes some unexpected twists. I've created 50 levels packed with deadly enemies and thrilling challenges to keep you on your toes.

If you played the first game, you’ll bump into some familiar faces, like the witch and Jan the Inventor, but there’s so much new to discover: new NPCs, deadlier enemies, helpful merchants, and...new playable characters!

That's right - Janosik won't face this adventure alone. He will be joined by three new playable characters: Bogdan, Janka, and Hugo. Each of them brings unique abilities that will alter the way you approach the game. I've also prepared a wide range of upgrades to go along with new characters - from weapons and movement abilities to special powers like freezing or electrifying enemies.

Today, the world of [b]Janosik 2[/b] is ready for you to explore. I can’t wait to see how you tackle its challenges, uncover its secrets, and interact with all the characters. Here’s to a journey full of excitement, surprises, and most importantly - fun!

Jump in, and make [b]Janosik 2[/b] an adventure to remember!

[h3][b]Get Janosik 2 now:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

- Marcin "Onix" Onysko

notes.title: Janosik 2 Coming Dec 9th! New Dungeons for Janosik Today!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've got a double dose of exciting news for you today! We've prepared a major update for Janosik with brand new content and features. On top of that, we're finally ready to let you all know when you will be able to embark on the next adventure in[b] Janosik 2[/b].

[h3][b]Janosik 2 is  launching on [b]December 9, 2024[/b]![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/267e8c2de4bd49602b6ca37b7d2c50266a2eebc6.png[/img]

The legend of the Slovakian Highlander continues.

The adventure picks up right after the events of [b]Janosik[/b]! Tricked by an ingenious ruse, Janosik must find a way to escape captivity and take the fight directly to Countess Bathory, who thinks she is pulling all the strings in the Highlands. Joined by Bogdan the Werewolf and Hugo the Vampire, and Janka the Plucky Maiden traverse through massive levels filled with mythical foes, deadly traps, and pesky De Blonde's goons.

With four unique playable characters, lightning-fast action, and a bigger world to explore, [b]Janosik 2[/b] is a bigger, bolder adventure you don’t want to miss. 

[h3][b]Wishlist now:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640400/Janosik_2/

[h3][b]Major Update for Janosik[/b][/h3]
You shouldn't show up at the release party in regular Janosik's slacks... It's a costume party, and we've got you covered!

To make sure you can dress for the occasion, and show off your heroic flair, we're introducing [b]4 new outfits for Janosik[/b], which you can unlock by completing brand new dungeons. 

To begin your quest for the stylish threads, you'll need to head through a newly added corridor that connects to the main hallway. Once inside, you'll find a room with outfit racks and four doors leading to different dungeons.

[b]Each dungeon contains 4 parts of a single outfit[/b] - a hat, a chest piece, trousers, and boots , once you collect them all, you can equip a stunning new look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/3a05b4a6641b382cc26a56313235fe05a665fd81.png[/img]
[list][*] [b]Robin Hood[/b]: A green outfit inspired by the legendary outlaw, perfect for a highlander known for stealing from the rich to give to the poor.
[*] [b]Knight[/b]: Gleaming silver armor that reflects the valor and strength of a true hero, who isn't afraid of any challenge.
[*] [b]Warlock Guy[/b]: Inspired by the Project Warlock series, a dark ensemble that channels the power of forbidden magic.
[*] [b]Musketeer[/b]: A bold yellow outfit that captures the flair and swashbuckling spirit of a daring adventurer.[/list]Prepare for [b]Janosik 2[/b] by diving into this update! With new dungeons to explore and stylish outfits to collect, this is the perfect time to warm up and rediscover the thrill of adventure. These challenges will test your mettle and reward you with treasures worthy of a true highlander.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38704363/bb94119a4649b14ddfc9d310628a35154b59fcf2.jpg[/img]

The Highlands are full of danger, but we're sure you have what it takes to overcome challenges ahead of you!

[h3][b]Play Janosik for free now: [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412170/Janosik__Highlander_Precision_Platformer/

notes.title: Dev Update: Fellowship of the Village
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Highlands are a beautiful place, flourishing with flowers, trees, and all kinds of plants, A sight to behold, you might say. Unfortunately, the presence of Countess Bathory and her goons makes them a really dangerous place. Janosik found this out the hard way having gotten captured and thrown into a dungeon when trying to make it to his date.

To help you survive the Highlands, and deal with the Countess' army, kind people around the village will offer to sell a variety of items that will surely boost your combat prowess, or make exploration easier. These items are not required to progress further in the game, but will surely come in handy when you want to become a treasure hunter, or explore all of the Highlands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/19c1e022e2ed4e9e109341e1b0929b145a998aeb.jpg[/img]

[b]Map of the Village[/b] - Allows you to check your surroundings, and see where all cool people, including vendors, and certain people of interest, hang out.

[b]Golden Compass[/b] - The magical compass unveils the location of treasures scattered around the levels on the map. Once you purchase this, all maps found in the future will have the treasure markers on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e284fa7bd2a996fb23ef9937e9052f552706c1b7.png[/img]

[b]Harpoon[/b] - Janosik and his friends surely are great swimmers, but, unfortunately, they didn't learn how to use their weapons underwater. Instead, they rely on the Harpoon, which makes the underwater combat possible. Another advantage of buying this weapon is the ability to break rocks underwater to reveal hidden passages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/d3d9139aa6cad1a24c5a04e1784aabb121e78d14.gif[/img]

[b]Eel Ring[/b] - Janosik once had the Sturgeon Ring in his possession. It allowed him to breathe underwater, Unfortunately, he lost it while he was taking a bath... Thankfully, the Witch at the Village has a similar trinket in her collection. The Magical Eel Ring will also let Janosik and his friends breathe underwater, hopefully they don't lose it this time.

[b]Ring of Dexterity[/b] - Janosik would make a great Gymnast, as he has honed the ability to roll around to perfection. Ring of Dexterity is an icing to the cake, as it allows Janosik to dodge enemy projectiles, while rolling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/996875c9e717c23bc796a64853fa5e1d5832b399.gif[/img]

[b]Potions[/b] - The witch is carefully brewing Potions in her hut, and offers them to people in need. These magical concoctions will completely refill your Health. Make sure to always have some tied to your belt, they will come in handy in the midst of battle.

To tackle the dangers of the Highlands, preparation is key. Whether you’re searching for hidden treasures, battling underwater foes, or when bullets are flying right at you, the right tools will make all the difference. Equip yourself wisely and take advantage of the items offered by friendly villagers. With their help, you'll be ready to face the challenges ahead, uncover the secrets of this treacherous land, and take fight directly to Countess Bathory.

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Nx6CmMNgrj]Discord server[/url] to join our Community and stay up to date with all things Janosik. 

Until next time!

notes.title: Meet the Vegetarian Vampire! - Janosik 2 Dev Update #5
notes.content:
Hey!

It’s been a while since our last [b]Dev Update[/b], but we’ve been working hard on the original game, Janosik - Highlander Precision Platformer’s [b]Big Update[/b]. If you haven’t tried it yet, make sure to check it out [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412170/Janosik__Highlander_Precision_Platformer/]here[/url][/b].

Let’s get back to the sequel. We are working on a third playable character - the Vampire. He’s very puzzling and interesting for a couple of reasons. For starters, he’s a [b]VEGETARIAN[/b]. Yes. That’s right. He prefers ketchup over blood. Preferably with fries. Well… let’s be honest, who doesn’t like good fries with ketchup? The better question is whether you put the ketchup on the fries or next to them…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e7627dd72f85398b5b2c0f6df169817344001ffc.gif[/img]

The vampire’s primary weapon is the [b]whip[/b], and he can glide on his cape to access those hard-to-reach places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/257b44577db04a5b8d2b73434b52d9a4bb6adfdf.gif[/img]

The vampire is also equipped with a [b]bow[/b]! In combination with gliding, it allows him to rain arrows from above and style on enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/42582d85a96d24ad28ecbeaac606a59c297893ec.gif[/img]

That would be it for this Dev Update. Now that we are back to work on Janosik 2, you can surely expect updates like that more frequently.

As always, please follow and wishlist Janosik 2, and spread the word. Make sure to join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/ensxn8yTvd]Discord[/url] to share your feedback and thoughts about our game!

See you next time!

notes.title: Janosik 2 Dev Update #3 - A map to find your way around
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s a brand new year, so it’s time for some fresh news about [b]Janosik 2[/b]’s development.

This update will be shorter than the previous ones, but we still wanted to let you know what we’ve been working on recently. 

So the next big feature we’re adding to Janosik 2 is [b]the MAP[/b]! We want it to be useful, as you’ll be able to see a few crucial things when using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/a128fd97d587bf0a3ba59b1e388af7c2006b35fb.gif[/img]

The map will be showing where your character is, and where all of the keys and doors are located. It will, without a doubt, help you [b]navigate through the levels[/b] and plan your adventures accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/0eceefb941ab8b9b0f12108c243d1cc56dd8814a.gif[/img]

Additionally, you’ll be able to see how many treasures you’ve collected in the levels. It should prove [b]very useful to completionists[/b], who want to collect 100% of the coins, jewels, and treasures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/dd526460d5ba0f2dd1ffcff10905a2a483d9591e.gif[/img]

Let us know what you think about the game and we hope to see you on [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]our official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: Janosik 2 Dev Update #2 - The rocks keep rolling, rolling, rolling…
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We thought we’d squeeze in a fresh round of [b]Janosik 2[/b] news before the Holidays. Let’s dive in!

First up, we’re working on an [b]Indiana Jones-style level[/b], where Janka has to run away from a giant boulder. It’s a classic scene from some of our favorite movies that we hope to bring you lots of fun. Don’t look back (or rather - on the left) and run as fast as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/347b8d8027a82752d01d9bf1cbdb657fa0d5cd7d.gif[/img]

While we’re on the topic of rocks, we’ve added a new boss to the game, we’re calling him the [b]Rolling Stone[/b] because it’s a rock golem that can turn into a ball of stone and... roll. Now that we’re writing this update, we’re realizing how rocky this joke is…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/ca949c68f031b6cd20a8308aa9f761e72af176d8.gif[/img]

So what else is made of stone? Hmm… walls! What can you do with walls? Climb them! [b]Wall climbing[/b] is the newest way to move across levels in Janosik 2. It creates a ton of design possibilities and brings a new dynamic to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/e012d8def0e2d7750749be3c1f66be8f0cad780d.gif[/img]

In the last update, we’ve introduced [b]Parallax Layers[/b] which add the depth effect by having multiple background images move at different speeds. Keep an eye on the gates in the background… which are also made of stone…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/f0ee25ecfc36f1054562faa8e4dad97546e7bd41.gif[/img]

That’s all for this [b]Dev Update[/b]. Remember to follow us on Steam and let us know what you think about the game. We also hope to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]official Discord[/url].

See you next time!

notes.title: Janosik 2 Dev Update #1 - To the Dark Forest and beyond
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Now that you can check the demo for [b]Janosik 2[/b], we really wanted to let you know about the recent progress on the game. We also intend to make these updates more frequent.

Let’s dive in!

Over the last few months, we’ve been working on [b]Act 2 of Janosik 2[/b]. Our three main heroes (highlander Janosik, Bogdan the Werewolf, and the Vampire) will rest for a bit, while this part of the story focuses on [b]Janka[/b], Janosik’s girlfriend, as she explores some dark and mysterious areas. Thankfully, Janka has some unique abilities to deal with the obstacles she faces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/60d8104b2f218458ed9bd4bd68359ca2cd4e4f4d.gif[/img]

For starters, Janka can light up small areas of the map for a short time thanks to her lantern. This will come in handy in the [b]Very Dark Caves[/b] area, where the lantern will be your only source of light. Without the lantern, you won’t be able to see obstacles, which should make these levels pretty challenging and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/93a72a1e2dfa699c229783c201b22f6a2d081311.gif[/img]

Once you get out of the caves, [b]The Dark Forest[/b] will be the second area you’ll visit as Janka. It is less dark than the caves, but shouldn’t be a walk in the park. It’s full of monsters, dangerous chasms, and a variety of traps. So step carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/cee00c5a592b197348d3976cb4522795b148b7f4.gif[/img]

Next, you’ll find yourself in the [b]Upside Down[/b], where you’ll learn that Janka’s lantern isn’t her only special ability. The [b]mirrors[/b] are the second new gameplay mechanic we’re introducing in Act 2. Touching a mirror turns Janka’s gravity upside down, allowing her to walk on a ceiling as if it was the floor. This can seem trippy and confusing at first but you’ll get around to beating those areas. Eventually. 

The fourth area of Act 2, [b]The Mysterious Mountain[/b], isn’t ready yet. And we don’t want to spoil it. Let’s just say that Janka may need some help from her boyfriend...

Aside from Act 2, we’ve been working on some general improvements. We’ve also been recently testing [b]parallax layers[/b], and the results are promising. Parallax layering creates the depth effect by having multiple background layers moving at different speeds. Keep an eye on the forest in the background and see for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648059/bc06291c4d50db447d81ea2326a9241c1356c0bf.gif[/img]

And finally, [b]Juhani Junkala[/b], the composer of Janosik 2’s soundtrack has finished working on the music for the main menu and you can listen to it below!

[previewyoutube=Mtk604FMTcw;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s all for this Dev Update. Let us know what you think about new features on the Steam forum or our [url=https://discord.gg/ensxn8yTvd]Retrovibe Discord[/url].

Remember to follow Janosik 2 here on Steam, wishlist the game, and tell your friends.

See you next time!

We’ve also been recently testing [b]parallax layers[/b], and the results are promising. Parallax layering creates the depth effect by having multiple background layers moving at different speeds.
